description: PHP class extending Vtiger_PDF_ContentViewer to customize the display and rendering of inventory content in PDF format, including header creation, cell borders, page handling, and watermark drawing.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_InventoryContentViewer
classes.description: A subclass of Vtiger_PDF_ContentViewer that manages the presentation of inventory data in PDF format, including headers, grid layout, multi-page handling, and watermarks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the grid column widths for inventory data.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Initializes and draws the header row for the inventory table in PDF.

methods.name: drawCellBorder
methods.description: Draws borders around cells, optionally with specified heights.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Controls the display flow, rendering pre-last and last pages.

methods.name: displayPreLastPage
methods.description: Renders inventory rows, handling page breaks and overflows, including comment and summary sections.

methods.name: displayLastPage
methods.description: Creates the final page, primarily to handle footer or ending content.

methods.name: drawStatusWaterMark
methods.description: Draws a translucent watermark text indicating creation status.
